# SDK Composition
## Rules
### Package identity and dependencies
- Path `packages/sdk/`, workspace name `sdk`
- Runtime deps ONLY `@specd/core` + `@specd/code-graph`
- MUST NOT depend on `@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`, plugins

### Layer structure
- Hexagonal per `default:_global/architecture`:
  - `src/composition/` — `openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`, `withOpenGraphProvider`
  - `src/orchestration/` — `buildProjectStatusSnapshot`, `runIndexProjectGraph`
  - `src/shared/` — internal helpers; NOT re-exported
  - `src/index.ts` — public barrel only
- No domain entities, application ports, or infrastructure adapters

### Public barrel exports
- `exports`: `"."`→`src/index.ts`; `"./ports"`→`@specd/core/ports`; `"./extensions"`→`@specd/core/extensions`
- Explicit exports (no `export * from '@specd/core'`):
  - Composition: `openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`, `withOpenGraphProvider`, `SdkHostContext`, `OpenSpecdHostInput`, `OpenSpecdHostResult`, `WithOpenGraphProviderOptions`
  - Orchestration: `buildProjectStatusSnapshot`, `runIndexProjectGraph` + I/O types
  - Core re-exports: bootstrap, `Kernel`, `createX` factories, repos, use-case I/O, entities, errors — track `kernel.specs` incl. `MaterializeSpecMetadata`, `GetSpecMetadata`, `RegenerateSpecMetadata`, `InitializePersistedSpecState`, schema inspect/reassign, dep/impl/opt use cases + `create*`
  - Code-graph `"."` re-exports (provider, host use cases, host-adapter symbols)
  - `SDK_VERSION`, `codeGraphVersion`, `getCodeGraphVersion`
- MUST NOT export infra/`./internal` symbols
- MUST NOT export `SaveSpecMetadata`, `UpdateSpecMetadata`, `InvalidateSpecMetadata` or their `create*` factories; MUST NOT export `PersistSpecMetadata`

### Public barrel exports for host adapters
- Re-export from `@specd/code-graph`: `acquireGraphIndexLock`, `assertGraphIndexUnlocked`, `createGetGraphHealth`, `GetGraphHealthInput`, `GetGraphHealthResult`, `IndexResult`, `HotspotResult`, `ImpactResult`, `FileImpactResult`, `codeGraphVersion`, `getCodeGraphVersion`, `GraphSpecNotFoundError`, `SymbolKind`, `SearchOptions`, `HotspotOptions`, `RiskLevel`, `normalizeFileSelectorPath`, `createBootstrapGraphConfig`, `isGraphStale`, `detectFingerprintMismatch`, `parseFingerprintMap`, `buildProjectGraphConfig`
- Delivery hosts MUST import these from `@specd/sdk`, not `@specd/code-graph`

### Import policy for integrators
- CLI/MCP/API/IPC using core+code-graph → depend `@specd/sdk` only
- Core-only packages (`plugin-*`, `skills`) MAY import `@specd/core`
- Storage implementers MAY use `@specd/core/ports` or `@specd/sdk/ports`; extensions similarly

### Version constant
- Export `SDK_VERSION` matching `package.json` version

## Constraints
- Thin composition + orchestration only; no infra duplication in hosts
